review_notes: Hub Ball is an unofficial baseball companion with live scores, box scores, schedules, standings, player statistics, curated headlines, prediction-market links, and an animated historical story. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Major League Baseball or either club. Live and published baseball data is delivered through the app's HTTPS backend. No account or login is required. The Markets screen links to third-party market pages; users cannot place wagers in the app.
